models: Kundur full 51-state gauge-removed model, P@7 and P@8, all four generator frequencies
WECC verified original descriptor, P@1 and P@4, all 29 generator frequencies; include only if independently qualified requested two-input transfer
contracts: committed common sign, amplitudes fixed forever
dynamic optional use, each block amplitudes independently in [0,a] with one common sign
fixed optional adoption, choose one b in [0,a] forever
comparators: one single sign repeated forever, including startup prefixes
refinement_rule: Double phase intervals if largest relative analytic interpolation error exceeds 2%; retain original and refined results, maximum 16384 intervals; no post-outcome ray selection
bounds: analytic modal tail plus phase-grid Lipschitz bound; tighter derivative grid plus analytic second-derivative bound allowed; floating computations, no interval proof
witnesses: Store worst finite common-sign and dynamic optional-use block sequences for every ray; direct original-state Kundur replay and descriptor-resolvent checks are independent verification
work_law: Conditional affine throughput w_i(t)=wbar_i+kappa_i deltaP_i(t), wbar_i>=abs(kappa_i)*a_i, baseline power Pbar_i>=a_i. Each port has exact zero incremental block energy and work wbar_i*T for every sign/amplitude. No empirical compute-power inference.
exclusions: No electrical state reset except labelled invalid comparator
No run-constrained language transfer in this bounded study
No unqualified WECC finite QZ realization
